tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of RO antiscalant -POYMERIC
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Delivery Period: The first consignment shall be dispatched within 15 days from the date of receipt of PO, as per the supply schedule issued by AGM(C)/YTPS. Subsequent consignments shall be dispatched over a period of one year, as per the supply schedule issued to be by AGM(Chem)/YTPS, based on the requirement..
Please refer tender document for all the terms and conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have supplied the RO Antiscalant of 3500 Kg and above to any thermal power plants/process industries/cement companies etc, and shall furnish single/multiple Purchase Order copies (Not more than 3 PO) as a proof issued by Chief Engineer/Project head/Competent authority.
The bidder shall be a manufacturer/authorized dealer/Regular supplier for RO Antiscalant as a proof relevant documents shall be furnished

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 4.9 lakh in at least two financial years, of the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Balance sheet and profit & loss account statements duly certified by a chartered accountant.

itemList.specifications: Specification:RO ANTISCALANT POLYMERIC TO EFFECTIVELY CONTROLL THE FEED WATER HAVING HIGHER SILICA AND POSPHATE AS FURNISHED BY OUR RAW WATER QUALITY.
